args.summary: The latest deployment v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Per runbook, we rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed successfully: all regions now run v2.3.0, health checks are passing, and error rate has dropped to 0.2%. v2.3.1 requires investigation before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back from unhealthy v2.3.1 to healthy v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging).

2. **Rolled back**: All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) rolled back to v2.3.0. Rollback approved and completed successfully.

3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy again with the error rate down to 0.2%.

4. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)**: Documented the rollback and current status; the on-call engineer has been paged. Recommended that v2.3.1 be investigated before any redeploy.
